sql: COPY s.t TO STDOUT (FORMAT badformat)

note: FORCE_QUOTE only valid for CSV format

sql: COPY s.t TO STDOUT (FORMAT binary, DELIMITER '|')
note: DELIMITER not allowed with binary format - syntax error 42601

sql: COPY s.t STDOUT
COPY TO STDOUT
note: missing table name or subquery - syntax error 42601

sql:
COPY (SELECT * FROM s.t) FROM STDIN;
\.
note: query form only valid with TO not FROM - syntax error 42601

sql:
COPY s.t FROM STDIN (FORMAT csv, FORCE_QUOTE (name));
\.
note: FORCE_QUOTE is TO-only, error in FROM context

sql: COPY s.t TO STDOUT (FORMAT csv, HEADER MATCH)
note: HEADER MATCH only valid for COPY FROM not COPY TO

sql: COPY s.t TO STDOUT (FORMAT csv, ON_ERROR ignore)
note: ON_ERROR only valid for COPY FROM, error on TO

sql: COPY s.t TO STDOUT (FORMAT binary, NULL 'x')
note: NULL option not allowed in binary format

sql:

\.

COPY s.t FROM STDIN (FORMAT csv, REJECT_LIMIT 10);
\.
note: REJECT_LIMIT without ON_ERROR ignore - semantic error
